description: The last 24 hours, country by country, like an election map: each country's leading story (the one the most of its own outlets covered), the stories leading in the most countries, and countries too quiet to call. Give country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for that country's stories: sort popular (its outlets), cited (stories that broke there, by how far outlets elsewhere picked them up) or relevant (what it covers more than the rest of the world). A country's list may carry one labeled paid placement.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. "DE"; omit for the whole map

name: live_map
title: What each country's news is covering now
